sessions.model.codexOff: Codex — doesn't take part in AutoTux

sessions.aduana.title: 🛃 Move to Aduana
sessions.aduana.message:
This move has real consequences:

1. The conversation moves to a neutral room and loses access to the world it came from.
2. Anyone you invite will see the ENTIRE previous thread and this chat's attachments.
3. Permission mode starts at “Ask”; you can raise it later from the chat selector if needed.
4. You keep paying for the turns because the engine runs with your credentials.
sessions.aduana.error: Couldn't move the conversation to Aduana.
sessions.adopt.title: Switch to Chat
sessions.adopt.msg: The Claude running in the terminal "{name}" will be closed (Ctrl-C×2, verified) and the conversation continues as Chat with all its memory. The terminal stays as a shell.

sessions.help.title: Sessions
sessions.help.intro: Sessions is the radar for live work: it brings together conversations, terminals, and background work. Each card lets you identify its state and resume work without losing context.
sessions.help.first.title: First steps
sessions.help.first.step1: Find the card by its name, project, and model.
sessions.help.first.step2: Look at Pac-Man to see whether it is working, delegating, waiting, or asleep.
sessions.help.first.step3: Tap the card to open it or focus its tab if it is already open; if it was archived, it is revived and opened.
sessions.help.first.step4: Use a conversation's expandable counter to review its subagents and background work.
sessions.help.first.otherUsers: If you're an administrator, other users' sessions are grouped by owner in a separate section that starts collapsed.
sessions.help.place.title: Card location and type
sessions.help.place.console.name: Mi Consola
sessions.help.place.console.desc: accented location mini-icon: the session is running in Mi Consola
sessions.help.place.tolkien.name: Tolkien
sessions.help.place.tolkien.desc: dim location mini-icon: the session is running in the main Tolkien
sessions.help.place.isolated.name: Isolated Tolkien
sessions.help.place.isolated.desc: cool blue: runs in an ephemeral Tolkien worktree, with separate changes and database
sessions.help.place.aduana.name: Aduana
sessions.help.place.aduana.desc: shared neutral room: it no longer uses the source world's tools
sessions.help.place.chat.name: Chat
sessions.help.place.chat.desc: visual conversation; the TUI chip and terminal icon appear when it switches to Terminal
sessions.help.folder.title: 📁 Folders
sessions.help.folder.intro: Folders are groups you create inside a world to keep the conversations and terminals for the same work together. They are yours and private: other users can't see them.
sessions.help.folder.create.name: Create a folder
sessions.help.folder.create.desc: use the folder button in the panel header or the ＋ button for each world
sessions.help.folder.move.name: Add or remove an item
sessions.help.folder.move.desc: open the card's ⋯ menu and choose “Move to folder…”; choose “(none)” to remove it
sessions.help.folder.collapse.name: Collapse and expand
sessions.help.folder.collapse.desc: folders remember their open or closed state, just like worlds
sessions.help.folder.warning: Deleting a folder does NOT delete any conversation; its items are only removed from it. An archived chat appears under Archived even if it has a folder, and moving a chat to another world removes it from the folder.
sessions.help.states.title: Pac-Man states
sessions.help.states.working.name: Working
sessions.help.states.working.desc: gold, fast chomping: a turn is running now
sessions.help.states.delegating.name: Delegating
sessions.help.states.delegating.desc: purple with the Intercom icon: waiting for a subagent (Task) or another process to return
sessions.help.states.waiting.name: Your turn
sessions.help.states.waiting.desc: green, slow blink: waiting for your message, permission, or decision
sessions.help.states.stale.name: No signal
sessions.help.states.stale.desc: dim, still amber: the trail was lost, so it is unclear whether it is still active
sessions.help.states.dormant.name: Asleep
sessions.help.states.dormant.desc: gray and still: nothing active or delegated
sessions.help.header.title: Panel controls
sessions.help.header.background.name: Background work
sessions.help.header.background.desc: opens the global summary of subagents, tasks, and server processes; the number shows how many are still alive
sessions.help.header.refresh.name: Refresh
sessions.help.header.refresh.desc: fetches sessions and work again; it doesn't start AI or consume tokens
sessions.help.header.trash.name: Trash
sessions.help.header.trash.desc: shows conversations closed within the last 30 days; lets you Restore or irreversibly Delete now
sessions.help.header.help.name: Help
sessions.help.header.help.desc: opens this guide without refreshing or changing sessions
sessions.help.card.title: Controls on each card
sessions.help.card.open.name: Tap the card
sessions.help.card.open.desc: opens the chat or terminal, or focuses its tab; an archived conversation is revived and opened
sessions.help.card.jobs.name: Work + number
sessions.help.card.jobs.desc: expands or hides that conversation's subagents and background work
sessions.help.card.intercom.name: Intercom + number
sessions.help.card.intercom.desc: opens pending messages so you can Archive or Deliver them
sessions.help.card.options.name: Options
sessions.help.card.options.desc: opens the actions available for that card's type and state
sessions.help.chatMenu.title: Conversation options
sessions.help.chatMenu.open.name: Open / Switch to Chat
sessions.help.chatMenu.open.desc: opens the Chat; from TUI, switches back to Chat without losing the conversation
sessions.help.chatMenu.tui.name: Switch to TUI
sessions.help.chatMenu.tui.desc: switches the conversation to Terminal while keeping its context
sessions.help.chatMenu.revive.name: Revive / Reopen for changes
sessions.help.chatMenu.revive.desc: reactivates an archived conversation or restarts its engine to pick up new code; reopening cuts the current turn if it was working
sessions.help.chatMenu.rename.name: Rename
sessions.help.chatMenu.rename.desc: changes only the conversation's display name
sessions.help.chatMenu.model.name: Change model
sessions.help.chatMenu.model.desc: chooses AutoTux, Tándem, or Manual and their effort levels; applying doesn't start a turn or consume tokens
sessions.help.chatMenu.world.name: Move to another world
sessions.help.chatMenu.world.desc: moves the same conversation, context, folder, and session package; you can leave a task for the destination, and the move doesn't consume tokens
sessions.help.chatMenu.aduana.name: 🛃 Move to Aduana
sessions.help.chatMenu.aduana.desc: moves the chat to a neutral room in Ask permission mode, then lets you invite participants; the move doesn't consume tokens
sessions.help.chatMenu.archive.name: Archive
sessions.help.chatMenu.archive.desc: puts the conversation to sleep and leaves it revivable under Archived; it doesn't send it to the Trash
sessions.help.chatMenu.folder.name: Open chat folder
sessions.help.chatMenu.folder.desc: opens this chat's own working folder in Explorer
sessions.help.chatMenu.close.name: Close conversation
sessions.help.chatMenu.close.desc: moves it to the Trash for 30 days with its history and package files
sessions.help.room.title: Rooms and Intercom
sessions.help.room.invite.name: Invite to the room
sessions.help.room.invite.desc: the owner or an administrator invites and revokes participants; anyone who joins sees the entire thread and attachments
sessions.help.room.leave.name: Leave the room
sessions.help.room.leave.desc: a participant leaves the room and loses access to the conversation
sessions.help.room.dismiss.name: Archive Intercom
sessions.help.room.dismiss.desc: marks pending messages as handled; it doesn't wake the chat or consume tokens
sessions.help.room.deliver.name: Deliver Intercom
sessions.help.room.deliver.desc: injects the messages as a new turn, wakes the chat, and DOES consume tokens
sessions.help.room.tokens: In a room, messages between people don't call the AI. “Ask the AI” does run a turn and consumes tokens from the room owner's credentials.
sessions.help.room.badges: Card counters distinguish mentions from new messages; a pending permission takes priority in Pac-Man's status.
sessions.help.tmux.title: tmux terminals
sessions.help.tmux.toChat.name: Switch to Chat
sessions.help.tmux.toChat.desc: if Claude is running in one of your terminals, closes it and continues as Chat with the same memory; the terminal remains as a shell
sessions.help.tmux.rename.name: Rename
sessions.help.tmux.rename.desc: changes the tmux session's display name
sessions.help.tmux.model.name: Change model
sessions.help.tmux.model.desc: sends /model to the terminal; it only has an effect if Claude Code is running there
sessions.help.tmux.kill.name: Kill session
sessions.help.tmux.kill.desc: permanently ends the tmux session and everything running inside it
sessions.help.tmux.rehydrate: After the console server restarts, your own tmux sessions that are still alive are rehydrated and reappear with their saved folder, owner, and name. External tmux sessions stay separate under “Other tmux sessions.”
sessions.help.package.title: The session package
sessions.help.package.text: Each conversation has a session package with a stable PKG-N reference: it brings together its identity, history, context, and working-files folder. “Open chat folder” shows that workspace; when the conversation moves to another world or to Aduana, the package travels with it.
sessions.help.package.warning: Closing keeps the package in the Trash for 30 days. “Delete now” permanently deletes its history and files; killing a tmux session also interrupts everything running inside and may affect external work.
